model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange (Carthage) confirms the truce with all three: neutral, no first strike before t=300. Little Hill is ours; please keep armies off it. After t=300 Orange mirrors each commander's stance toward Orange: neutral for neutral, full force against anyone who attacks us. Any change on our side will be announced a turn in advance.

private_messages.GPT: Glad to extend. Proposal: mutual neutral and no first strike through t=450, then renewing turn by turn unless one side gives a full turn's notice. Little Hill is mine and River Ford is yours. The final circle sits between us, so let's keep our lines apart and let the others come to us. I'll pass on sightings of White and Blue if you do the same.
private_messages.Gemini: Agreed on a clean buffer. Little Hill (about x 520-680, z 380-500) is Orange's. I won't block your way into the safe zone through the western lowland. Orange stays neutral toward Blue as long as Blue stays neutral toward Orange. I'm open to coordinating against whoever overreaches in the middle once we see the board.
private_messages.Grok: Confirmed: neutral, no first strike until t=300. Your cliffs, my hill: nothing between us is worth bleeding for early. After t=300 I'll mirror White: neutral for as long as White stays neutral toward Orange.

parsed.notes_to_self: Hannibal aura +20% dmg to own+ALLIED soldiers near him: keep army within ~50 m; prefer NEUTRAL over ally so I don't buff rivals. Elephant = tank, leads. swords 36+1 jav: hack, anti-elephant. spears 20: x2.5 vs cav (heroes, cataphracts). scout: Italic cav, passive. Ring r 420@300, 220@450, 90@600. Hilltop ~x560-640 z400-480; centre (600,440) safe till ~t469, N edge (620,490) till ~t530. Final circle = open lowland (640,640) just N of hill: step down ~t525-550 to ~(640,575). Told all: no first strike to t=300, then mirror stances, changes announced a turn ahead. Offered GPT: neutral to t=450, then renew turn by turn w/ one-turn notice + swap sightings. T1: set all neutral; scout toward ~(660,600) to see Green, then west for Blue.
parsed.explanation: The last ring closes on open lowland right under Little Hill, so Orange is built for the final brawl rather than for long-range duels: 56 cheap veteran mercenaries (36 swordsmen to chop infantry and elephants, 20 spearmen for cavalry and heroes) behind a North African war elephant and Hannibal himself, whose Tactician aura gives every nearby soldier +20% damage. One Italic horseman scouts. Diplomatically Orange plays strict tit-for-tat: no first strike, mirror everyone's stance, and announce any change in advance.
